_help: trend-watch file decay policy, read by `trend-watch decay` (trend_watch/decay.py).
Covers FILES under the state dir only. state.db rows are pruned separately by the
Each rule: path (relative to the state dir), glob (matched against entry names
directly inside path), max_age_days (entry mtime older than this is eligible),
keep_last (the newest N matching entries are never eligible, whatever their age).
kind: 'file' or 'dir' (dir entries are removed whole). Default is dry-run;
`trend-watch decay --apply` removes and logs to logs/decay.jsonl.
never: paths (relative to the state dir) no rule may ever touch.

<config>/decay.json, when present, replaces this seed entirely: copy this file there and add rules, for example for a pack's <state>/<pack>/log/*.jsonl daily logs; list the pack's database and outbox/sent/failed dirs under never.

rules.name: run-logs
rules.why: Run logs retained for recent troubleshooting.

rules.name: delivered-outbox
rules.why: Copies of outputs already delivered by flush.

rules.name: pre-migrate-backups
rules.why: Database snapshots taken before schema migrations.

rules.name: manual-backups
rules.why: Manual database backups; keep the newest two.

rules.name: pre-restore-backups
rules.why: Database snapshots taken before restoring a backup; keep the newest one.
